blocks.text: Group 2 dhaatein halke tezaabon se react kar ke namak aur hydrogen gas deti hain, aur reactivity group mein neeche barhti hai. Beryllium halke tezaabon se BeCl2 aur hydrogen banata hai, halanke oxide teh reaction dheema kar sakti hai. Magnesium halke hydrochloric ya sulphuric acid se aasani se react karta, aur calcium tezi se: Ca(s) + 2HCl(aq) -> CaCl2(aq) + H2(g).

blocks.title: Calcium aur sulphuric acid
blocks.text: Sulphuric acid ke saath calcium ka reaction jaldi ruk sakta hai, kyunke banne wala calcium sulphate thora ghulta aur dhaat par hifazati teh chadha deta hai.

blocks.prompt: (i) calcium aur oxygen aur (ii) barium aur paani ke mua'adlat likhein.
Andaza lagayein ke radium ki kasafat aur pighalne ka darja barium se kaise muqabla karenge.
blocks.explanation: Rujhan ke mutabiq radium barium se zyada ghana (3.51 g/cm3 se oopar) hona chahiye; pighalne ke darje Ca se Ba tak be-qaida ghat'te hain, is liye radium ka darja barium ke barabar ya zara kam hone ki tawaqqo hai.
